name: Level_1 - Task_5
description: Evaluate the adsorption energy of a Carbon Monoxide (CO) molecule on a Platinum (111) surface. Construct a Pt(111) surface slab consisting of a 2 × 2 surface cell with 4 atomic layers and 10 Å of vacuum padding. Apply kinematic constraints to fix the atomic positions of the bottom two layers of the slab. Position a CO molecule such that its Carbon atom sits directly at an atop site above a surface Pt atom, with an initial vertical separation of 1.8 Å from the topmost slab layer. The MACE-MP-0 foundation model should be used as the ASE-compatible calculator to describe interatomic interactions. Perform geometry optimization using the BFGS optimizer until the maximum atomic force falls below 0.05 eV/Å for three distinct configurations: the combined CO-adsorbed slab system, the clean reference Pt(111) slab, and an isolated reference CO molecule centered within a cell containing 5 Å of vacuum padding. Calculate the adsorption energy of the system based on these relaxed reference states. Return the calculated adsorption energy as a floating-point value in eV.
